description: Reviewed region/grape questions for the Phase 2 body-only versus contextual-search ablation.

requirements: Each question requires both regional and grape-specific evidence.
Each sample has curated ground-truth chunk IDs for deterministic retrieval scoring.
The cohort covers multiple countries, grapes, wine colors, and question intents.

samples.evaluation_focus: Distinguish two neighboring appellations that share the same grape.
Retrieve appellation-specific permitted varieties rather than generic grape descriptions.
Contrast one region's Chardonnay style with the wider parent region.
Associate an appellation with its grape and characteristic regional style.
Resolve a grape synonym while retrieving its regional growing context.
Connect synonymous grape names to geographically distinct wine contexts.
Retrieve an indigenous grape through Romanian regional lineage.
